metaDescription: If candlesticks vanished from your TradingView chart, here's how to use the visibility toggle to bring them back in seconds.
intro: If your candlesticks suddenly seem to have disappeared from a TradingView chart, it's usually not a glitch, just a visibility setting that got toggled off accidentally. This guide shows how to find and use the eye icon to bring your candles back.

steps.heading: Open the chart with missing candles
steps.body: Go to the chart section on TradingView where you noticed the candlesticks have disappeared.

steps.heading: Check the right toolbar
steps.body: Look at the object tree and data window area on the right side of the chart, which manages visibility for chart elements.

steps.heading: Find the eye icon next to the symbol name
steps.body: This icon toggles visibility for the price data on your chart, and it may have been accidentally clicked off.

steps.heading: Click the eye icon to restore visibility
steps.body: Clicking it reactivates the candlesticks so they reappear on your chart.

steps.heading: Confirm the candles are back
steps.body: Return to your chart view and check that the candlesticks display normally again.

steps.heading: Watch for accidental toggles
steps.body: Keep in mind that other chart elements can be hidden the same way, so check visibility settings if something else seems to go missing.

faq.question: Why did my candles disappear on TradingView?
faq.answer: This usually happens when the visibility toggle for the symbol was accidentally turned off, not because of a technical glitch.

faq.question: How do I get my candles back?
faq.answer: Click the eye icon next to the symbol name in the object tree to restore candle visibility.

faq.question: Where is the eye icon located?
faq.answer: It's found in the right-side toolbar near the object tree and data window, next to the symbol's name.

faq.question: Does this affect my other chart data or indicators?
faq.answer: No, toggling the eye icon for the symbol only affects candlestick visibility, not your saved indicators or drawings.

faq.question: Can other chart elements be accidentally hidden too?
faq.answer: Yes, similar visibility toggles exist for other chart elements, so it's worth checking those if something else seems missing.
